description: National Heavy Vehicle Network Map is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by National Heavy Vehicle Regulator. The National Heavy Vehicle Regulator (NHVR) National Network Map is an interactive resource that shows the network maps and approved roads available for road freight transport vehicles, special purpose vehicles and load carrying vehicles. The National Network Map contains the routes/journeys which heavy vehicles can travel across state and territory borders at a national level. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as daily, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-06-20. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
